methods.label: Crush melee and webs
methods.summary: Use fast crush weapons, clear web movement constraints, and respond to Sarachnis spawns.
requiredOrKeyItems: Knife or slash option for webs
steps: Use crush-focused melee gear because Sarachnis is weak to crush.
Attack while keeping enough space to react to webbing.
Cut or wait out webs depending on positioning and supply pressure.
Resume melee once movement is restored.
risks: Webs can trap the player in bad positions.
Ignoring spawns can increase incoming damage quickly.

methods.label: Spawn and prayer management
methods.summary: Handle Sarachnis spider spawns and prayer choices while keeping melee DPS on the boss.
prayers: Protect from Magic if prioritising mage spawn pressure
steps: Watch for spider spawns and kill or tank them based on trip goals.
Wear enough magic defence to reduce magic spawn damage.
Keep offensive melee prayer active when supplies allow.
Bank when food runs low rather than risking a webbed death.
notes: High magic and ranged defence make non-melee styles poor default choices.
